text:
maria: Hey folks — opened PR #512 for the Private Deploy migration guide. Netlify preview link is up but the left sidebar/TOC looks like the old version (shows sections we removed). Can someone sanity-check? https://app.netlify.com/sites/redwood-docs/deploys/abcd1234

sam: I can take a look. Does the preview URL show the new permalink structure or the old one?

maria: It shows the old permalinks. I rebuilt locally with mkdocs and got the updated sidebar, so it's only on Netlify preview.

leo: This smells like a cached search index / plugin mismatch. Netlify cache sometimes keeps previous site_dir artifacts. Try adding NETLIFY_BUILD_USE_CACHE=false or purge the deploy cache from the UI.

sam: Also double-check the mkdocs-material version in docs/requirements.txt — if Netlify is installing a different mkdocs-material the theme plugin might generate a different mkdocs.yml interpretation. I had this before where local pip env was 9.x and netlify pip defaulted to 8.x.

maria: Good call. docs/requirements.txt pins mkdocs==1.3.0 and mkdocs-material==8.1.0. Netlify build log shows mkdocs 1.2.2 earlier in the steps though.

ci-bot: deploy-status: Netlify deploy abcd1234 finished (success). Build command: pip install -r docs/requirements.txt && mkdocs build -f docs/mkdocs.yml. Cache restored from previous build.

leo: If cache was restored, pip might have used cached wheels from earlier build image. Two options: (1) purge Netlify cache and re-trigger, (2) bump a trivial file in docs/ to force new content hash, (3) set NETLIFY_CACHE_DIR to a new path. I usually do option 1 for quick testing.

maria: Trying purge now and re-triggering. If that fails I'll push a docs/.cache-bust file with current timestamp.

sam: If you go the cache-bust route, add it to .gitignore so we don't keep committing noise. Also add a short note to the PR saying why (so reviewers aren't surprised).

toni: On approvals — who should review this migration guide? @sam can do accuracy + examples, @leo for devex/local preview instructions, and I can do copy/marketing voice. Can we aim to merge during the 2–3pm PST quiet window?

maria: Sounds good. I requested review from sam and leo. I'll add a changelog entry and the local preview steps that leo suggested.

leo: Local preview snippet to add to the PR description for folks who want to run locally quickly:
```
python -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -r docs/requirements.txt
cd docs
mkdocs serve -a 0.0.0.0:8000
```
Note: If you see an outdated sidebar locally, delete docs/site/ and rebuild.

sam: Quick note for CI: add a check in .github/workflows/docs-preview.yml to echo mkdocs --version and list pip freeze so the deploy logs make it obvious which versions were used. That will save debugging time later.

maria: Rebuild after purge succeeded — preview now shows updated TOC. Thanks all. I'll wait for the two approvals and then merge in the afternoon slot.

toni: Great. If either of you see any stray layout regressions let me know — we can rollback or do a quick patch. :thumbsup:

sam: Approved in the PR.

leo: Approved. Left a tiny nit about the example command output but not blocking.

maria: Merging at 14:10 PST. Thanks team!
